source_refs.note: Book p. 205-206: 11.4.1 Graphs of Trigonometric Functions: the five plotting steps (i)-(v), steps (iv)-(v) on p. 206, 'smooth curves' in bold.

blocks.text: Ab tak hum trigonometric functions ki values numbers ki shakal mein dekh rahe the. Ab hum inhein tasveer ki shakal mein dekhenge, yani graph (naqsha) banayenge. Graph ka faida yeh hai ke ek nazar mein pata chal jata hai ke angle barhne se function ki value kab barhti hai, kab ghat-ti hai, sab se ziada kahan hai aur sab se kam kahan. Pehle yeh seekhte hain ke kisi bhi trigonometric function ka graph kin qadmon (steps) se banta hai.
Kitab ke mutabiq graph plot karne ke liye hum yeh steps follow karenge:

items: (i) Ordered pairs \((x, y)\) ki table banai jati hai, jahan \(x\) angle ki measure hai aur \(y\) us angle par trigonometric function ki value;
(ii) Angles ki measures \(X\)-axis par li jati hain;
(iii) Trigonometric functions ki values \(Y\)-axis par li jati hain;
(iv) Ordered pairs wale points graph paper par plot kiye jate hain;
(v) In points ko smooth curves (hamwaar, baghair kone wale kham) ki madad se jora jata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Function ka graph hota kya hai? Har angle \(x\) (input, yani jo hum dete hain) ke liye function ek value \(y\) (output, yani jo humein milta hai) deta hai. Yeh jori \((x, y)\) graph paper par ek point ban jati hai. Misaal: \(\sin 30^{\circ} = 0.5\), to \(y = \sin x\) ke graph par point \((30^{\circ}, 0.5)\) aayega. Jab hum bohat saare aise points laga kar unhein jor dete hain to tasveer ban jati hai jo batati hai ke angle ke saath value kaise badalti hai.
Steps (ii) aur (iii) ko yun yaad rakhiye: angle 'kya diya' hai, is liye woh leti hui line (\(X\)-axis) par; function ki value 'kya mila' hai, is liye woh khari line (\(Y\)-axis) par.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: \(X\)-axis par degrees likhein ya radians? Dono chalte hain. Bas yeh rishta yaad rakhiye: \(\pi\) radians \(= 180^{\circ}\). Is se har degree ka radian naam nikal aata hai, jaise \(30^{\circ} = \frac{180^{\circ}}{6} = \frac{\pi}{6}\). Agle sabaq ki tables mein dono likhe hote hain, jaise '\(\frac{\pi}{6}\) or \(30^{\circ}\)'. Neeche ki table mein main marks ke dono naam hain:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Step (v) mein kitab ne 'smooth curves' par zor diya hai. Ruler se seedhi lines kyun nahin? Kyun ke function ki value do points ke darmiyan bhi aahista aahista, baghair jhatke ke badalti hai. Ek chhota sa test dekhiye: \((30^{\circ}, 0.5)\) aur \((60^{\circ}, 0.87)\) ko seedhi line se jorein to beech mein \(45^{\circ}\) par line ki unchai taqreeban \(0.68\) hogi. Lekin asal value \(\sin 45^{\circ} \approx 0.71\) hai, yani asal graph seedhi line se thora upar se guzarta hai. Is liye points ko haath se ek hamwaar (smooth) curve se jorte hain, jaise kisi pahari raaste ka dheere dheere mur-na.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar \(y = \cos x\) ka graph banana ho to \(x = 60^{\circ}\) par kaun sa point lagega? Jawab: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = 0.5\), is liye point \((60^{\circ}, 0.5)\). Aur \(x = 90^{\circ}\) par? \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), to point \((90^{\circ}, 0)\), yani graph yahan \(X\)-axis ko chhoo kar guzrega.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Paper mein graph ke sawal par in cheezon ke marks hote hain: scale likha hua ho, dono axes ke naam (\(X\), \(Y\)) aur angle ke marks, points sahi jagah par, curve smooth ho, aur upar title ho, jaise 'Graph of \(y = \sin x\)'. Tez nok wali pencil istemal kijiye aur curve ek hi dafa mein, halke haath se khenchiye; baar baar mitane se graph ganda ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Pehle ordered pairs \((x, y)\) ki table banayein.
2. Angles \(X\)-axis par, function ki values \(Y\)-axis par.
3. Points plot karein, phir unhein ek smooth curve se jorein.
4. \(\pi\) radians \(= 180^{\circ}\); \(X\)-axis par dono mein se koi bhi unit chal sakti hai, magar poore graph mein ek jaisi.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Ruler se points jorna: graph tedhi-medhi (zig-zag) lines ka ban jata hai jis mein nukeele kone hote hain, jab ke trigonometric graph mein koi kona nahin hota.
2. Axes ulat dena, yani values \(X\)-axis par aur angles \(Y\)-axis par.
3. Angles ke marks ke darmiyan faasla barabar na rakhna: har \(30^{\circ}\) ka faasla graph paper par bilkul barabar hona chahiye, warna curve ki shakal bigar jati hai.
